description: A script for generating and inserting CAMEO tags into U-Boot images for OpenWrt firmware, specifically tailored for D-Link DGS-1210 switches. It manipulates uImage headers and root filesystem images to embed verification tags and checksums.

methods.name: read_buffer
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the uImage file at a given offset.

methods.name: write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the uImage file at a specified position.

methods.name: cameosum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum by summing all bytes in a buffer and returning a 4-byte big-endian value.

methods.name: invertcrc
methods.description: Computes the CRC32 of a buffer, XORs with 0xffffffff, and returns a 4-byte little-endian value.

methods.name: checksum_header
methods.description: Modifies a uImage header buffer to embed CAMEO tags and checksums, ensuring header integrity.
